scope.classification: descriptive conditional shared-phase surrogate method control
prohibited_inferences: neural or causal mechanism from this comparison alone
scope.no_outcome_target: All numerically valid directions, p-values, ratios and explicitly undefined states are admissible; no prose, historic bank or effect band is graded.
scope.source_selection: Preserve explicit old30 membership; sorted literal IDs, not the current loader's first30, and not value-selected.

source.source_structure: Parent-gated authenticated metadata/header/atlas-only inspection passed: all30 BOLD grids61x73x61, spatial units mm, temporal units sec, all48 labels supported. Original cortical XML text is stripped only. Functional voxel finiteness, global/local activity, cleaning rank and statistical endpoints remain uninspected before this freeze.
source.clock: All original frames, order0..T-1; operational frame time index*exact per-person NIfTI header TR, origin0, no precise rest/movie onset claim. Header temporal units sec/msec/usec are converted to seconds with0.1<TR<10 and0.08<Nyquist. NeuroImage header1.9600000381469727sec is retained, not overwritten by documentary1.96sec. For documentary consistency, convert documentary seconds into the declared header time units, represent at NIfTI1 float32 pixdim precision, then convert back to seconds; compare with header using atol1e-9/rtol1e-9. Frozen operational TR maps also use atol1e-9/rtol1e-9. This precision check does not alter any signal or clock.
source.nonfinite: All voxels contributing to any of the48 geometrically supported ROIs must be finite at every original frame, checked BEFORE global signal activity. BOLD voxels outside their union may be nonfinite and are ignored; every source byte is still authenticated. Atlas values must all be finite integers0..48. All13 selected confound columns must be finite and complete. No fillna, censoring, shortened source or selective person omission. Unsupported source preconditions fail the run, distinct from mathematical undefined endpoint support.
source.source_identity_join: Canonical seven-digit IDs join only to finite exact decimal-integer Subject values; preserve source_participant_token and original table headers. A single leading unnamed phenotype column is a documentary index, never participant identity. Site joins are literal, not stripped or guessed. Confound headers cannot be unnamed.

numerical_reference.scope: Pinned reference runtime for the declared numerical recipe; reported software strings are descriptive provenance, not an extra output-version fingerprint. Shared deterministic kernel and shared low-level routines are disclosed, not claimed independently implemented inference.

spatial_extraction.dtype: Calibrated float64 source BOLD; no float32 mean-storage roundtrip. Both source atlas and BOLD spatial units must be mm.
spatial_extraction.atlas_to_bold: Source labels with no intensity-selected mask; target is each original BOLD grid. Transform=scipy.linalg.inv(atlas_affine)@bold_affine; scipy.ndimage.affine_transform(labels,matrix=transform[:3,:3],offset=transform[:3,3],output_shape=bold_shape3,order=0,mode='constant',cval=0,prefilter=False), always full3x3 matrix, no diagonal-vector branch. Exactly equal shape and affine =>direct copy; equal affine and different shape=>identity transform. Nearest-tie/boundary semantics follow pinned SciPy; geometry does not assert a new anatomical registration.
spatial_extraction.labels: Original cortical XML label index+1 and text.strip(); no renaming or heuristic hemisphere split
spatial_extraction.mean: For each source ROI label, use ascending C-flat voxel indices and np.mean(np.ascontiguousarray(calibrated_volume_flat[indices],dtype=float64),dtype=float64)
spatial_extraction.geometry_empty: Keep ROI identity, false geometry flag, zero support count and explicit finite raw-zero sentinel; it cannot supply an edge. No nearest-voxel rescue.
spatial_extraction.support_digest: SHA256(b'FCVAR_support_v3\n' + shape3.astype('<i8').tobytes() + selected_affine4x4.astype('<f8').tobytes(order='C') + ascending_C_flat_indices.astype('<i8').tobytes()); exact shape/affine binding, no float serialization in digest

temporal_cleaning.input_layout: C-contiguous float64 [original frame, original ROI/declared confound]
temporal_cleaning.detrend: For Y and C separately: subtract NumPy float64 columnmean; centered arange(T) divided by sqrt(sum(trend**2)); subtract np.dot(trend,matrix)*trend[:,None]. Preserve C layout.

filter.output_layout: Explicit C-contiguous float64 copy after sosfiltfilt; no trimming or cutoff coercion

temporal_cleaning.confound_standardization: Subtract NumPy float64 columnmeans; divide by NumPy populationSD(ddof0), replacing SD<eps64 by1 as explicit recipe
temporal_cleaning.projection: Y-(Q@Q.T)@Y, preserving this explicit association, then subtract NumPy columnmean
temporal_cleaning.standardization: For canonical globally active residual columns only, accurately center and divide by positive stable sampleSD(ddof1). Compute equivalently in scaled coordinates to avoid a tiny physical divisor; no absolute SD epsilon floor. Inactive cleaned columns are exactly zero.
temporal_cleaning.scope: Explicit Nilearn0.13.1-inspired recipe. Shared low-level SciPy routines and declared layout; not unconditional library API equivalence or ideal mathematical QR rank. Rank is the declared operational threshold, not an outcome gate.

stable_global_arithmetic.exact_constant: All values equal the first value => centered vector and norm exactly zero
stable_global_arithmetic.center: For nonconstant finite vector x, scale=max(abs(x)); c=x/scale-math.fsum(x/scale)/len(x)
stable_global_arithmetic.norm: a=max(abs(c)); L2(x_centered)=scale*a*sqrt(math.fsum((c/a)**2)); zero a=>0. Nonfinite arithmetic fails explicitly.
stable_global_arithmetic.activity: geometry_present AND raw_centered_norm>0 AND prestandardization_residual_centered_norm>1e-12*raw_centered_norm; strict>, no absolute signal-unit floor
stable_global_arithmetic.retained_edges: Every unordered pair of globally active canonical ROIs in ascending original ROI ID; same personal edge set for all windows/draws. All48 ledger identities remain present.

window_statistic.local_layout: C-contiguous float64 [window start, original frame within window, ascending retained ROI]
window_statistic.local_center_norm: Per window/ROI scale=maxabs; divide by scale (zero=>1), subtract np.mean along frame axis(dtype=float64), exactconstant windows set exactly0; a=maxabs(centered); norm_scaled=a*sqrt(np.sum((centered/a)**2,axis=frame,dtype=float64)), zero a=>0. Physical norm=scale*norm_scaled.
window_statistic.local_activity: Canonical local norm >1e-12*sqrt(W/T)*canonical ORIGINAL full-cleaned centerednorm, strict>. The original full norm is fixed for every draw; do not use a surrogate's rounded/full norm.
window_statistic.undefined_slot: Fewer than2 globally active ROIs =>insufficient_rois; else fewer than2 windows=>insufficient_windows; else any retained ROI canonically inactive in any window=>undefined_window_correlation. Entire scalar slot null, no per-window edge/window dropping.
window_statistic.pearson: unit=local_scaled_center/norm_scaled; C-contiguous unit then batched np.matmul(unit.transpose(0,2,1),unit). Reject nonfinite or |r|>1+1e-12 as numerical failure. No epsilon denominator.
window_statistic.edge_sd: C-contiguous [window,edge] Fisher values z; centered=z-np.mean(z,axis=0,dtype=float64); sqrt(np.sum(centered**2,axis=0,dtype=float64)/(n_windows-1)); literal constant z columns have exactzero SD
window_statistic.statistic: float(np.mean(edge_sd,dtype=float64)); equal fixed-edge weighting, valid nonnegative zero allowed
window_statistic.computational_authority: Shared public deterministic signal_kernel arithmetic for oracle/verifier exact-inclusive ranking; this is intentionally not an independently implemented inference algorithm. Independent source reconstruction and artifact replay still test provenance and computation.

surrogates.phase_draws: uniform(0,2*np.pi,size=(50,T//2+1)), full row-major draw sequence; afterwards setDC0 and even-T Nyquist0. Never skip draws for overwritten bins.
surrogates.transform: np.fft.irfft(np.fft.rfft(accepted_clean,axis=0)*np.exp(1j*canonical_phase)[:,None],n=T,axis=0); same phase across all ROI columns; C-contiguous output; no recleaning or per-window FFT
surrogates.phase_authority: Regenerated phases only; submitted phase arrays are serialization receipts and cannot perturb the transform
surrogates.duplicates: Retain every draw slot, even equal phase/statistic values; no retries or rejection sampling
surrogates.interpretation: Finite-record conditional shared-phase comparison preserving Fourier cross-spectra, not a generally calibrated stationarity/causal/neural test

fidelity.relative_rule: norm(center(accepted)-center(canonical))/norm(center(canonical)), no absolute denominator floor, no second threshold on accepted support. Global uses stable_global_arithmetic; local uses declared batched scaled arithmetic. Apply to original and canonical-phase surrogate local windows. Canonical inactive windows never become active from jitter.
fidelity.inactive_clean: Canonical finite zero sentinel; accepted inactive/geometry-empty receipts may differ within the same public pointwise bound. Fixed canonical masks ignore these entries; tolerated jitter never reactivates support. No extra exact-zero serialization gate.
fidelity.discrete: All IDs, counts, source/order facts, ranks, Boolean masks and statuses exact. No hidden reference result or statistical direction check.

inference.rank: If observed and all50 null scalars defined, E=sum(null>=observed) using exact unrounded single accepted-series replay, inclusive>=, no tie epsilon
inference.fraction: p=(1+E)/51; numerator/count exact; denominator51 always retained
inference.significant: Strict alpha0.05 via integer20*(1+E)<51; null if incomplete
inference.incomplete: Any undefined required scalar =>count/numerator/p/significance null; preserve all50 draw rows and actual n_defined. Individually defined draw/observed values remain reportable.
inference.null_mean: math.fsum(all50 null scalars)/50 only when all50 defined
inference.ratio: observed/null_mean only when both defined and null_mean>0; else null. zero_null_mean invalidates ratio alone; allzero scalars yield E50,p1.
inference.nonfinite_derived: Fail explicitly; do not serialize infinity, substitute zero, drop a participant or relabel as a successful complete numerical result

groups.policy: Each metric separately requires every30 person values, else value null/status incomplete_support and actual n_defined
groups.means: math.fsum(values in canonical participant order)/30; equal person weighting
groups.median: Sort unrounded p values; mean of two middle values using math.fsum/2 for30people
groups.authority: Single accepted-cleaned-signal replay; CSV/scalar receipts never become inputs to another statistic. Mean ratios is not ratio of means. No available-case nanmean or pooled window/edge weighting.

numerical_amendments_from_legacy: Full float64 source means and explicit C-layout cleaning instead of dtype/layout-dependent masker defaults
Closed full13 confounds without silent intersection/fillna0
Canonical scale-invariant prestandardization global support and local conditioning rather than post-zscore SD threshold
Active positive stable sampleSD normalization without absolute epsilon floor
Mathematical two-window minimum rather than undocumented four-window skip
Shared deterministic statistic kernel for exact rank ties and complete metric-specific undefined propagation
All source/phase-bound inference is outcome-neutral; historic scalar/prose/bank bands removed
execution: Source structure and numerical method are frozen before original BOLD numerical decoding. This document does not authorize original numerical execution: final schema, reviewed code, source-free qualification and an explicit separate resource/run gate remain required.
